validator.source_text:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<scxml xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2005/07/scxml" version="1.0" datamodel="ecmascript" initial="s">
  <state id="s">
    <invoke type="http://www.w3.org/TR/scxml/">
      <content>
        <scxml xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2005/07/scxml" version="1.0" datamodel="null" initial="c">
          <state id="c"> <transition event="go" target="d"/></state>
          <final id="d"/>
        </scxml>
      </content>
    </invoke>
    <transition event="done.invoke" target="f"/>
  </state>
  <final id="f"/>
</scxml>

notes: structural SCXML elements such as `<state>` contain only child elements; stray text is usually a misplaced value or an unclosed tag
diagnostics.help: remove the text; put values in `<data>`, `<content>`, `<script>`, or a `<log expr="…">`
spec_references: XML Schema 1.0 Part 1 §3.4.4 Element Locally Valid (Complex Type) (`cvc-complex-type.2.3`)
